annotations.title: List an app in the gallery

description: Lists the app in Neblla's public gallery, at once. It does not publish files: that is neblla_promote "save" env "pro", needed first (pro must have an index.html). Required in one call: kind, themes, titles and descriptions, with at least one language having both. Shown only to visitors of the languages given; nothing is translated. neblla_unpublish_app hides it. More: neblla_get_llms tools/publish_app

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

avatar.description: true shows the «compatible with Mundo» seal (guide chapter mundo).

bestOn.description: The device it suits best; left out, both.

defaultLang.description: The language titles, descriptions and tags are written in.

descriptions.description: Required: the description per language, up to 500 characters each.

kind.description: Required: "game", "app" or "web"; the gallery filters by it.

modes.description: How it is played or used, several allowed; left out, Neblla suggests them from the app.

playerMoves.description: Mundo: true lets players bring the moves (dances, greetings) they bought.

playerMovesOff.description: Product ids of moves not allowed even with playerMoves.

portrait.description: The cover image: an http(s) URL, a data: URI or raw base64, scaled to 400x400.

sandbox.description: Mundo: true lets the powers of store items a player wears (speed, jump, fly) work in this app.

section.description: Retired: refused; use kind, modes and themes.

tags.description: Your own tags, as words in defaultLang.

tagsByLang.description: The tags' names per language, e.g. { en: ["pirates"], es: ["piratas"] }.

themes.description: Required: what it is about, 1 to 3; the gallery filters by them.

titles.description: Required: the title per language, e.g. { en: "My App", es: "Mi App" }.

name: neblla_publish_app
title: List an app in the gallery
